_comment: What tools/resource-ledger.py cannot read from the data. Every gap entry needs its reason.
structures: the name a structure or gate site goes by in the ledger.
equipment: items a player uses directly, so they need a source but no use. Named one by one: a 'namespace:*' here would let a new component or material skip the use check.
used_by_code: items code consumes, with what it does. They count as used.
tag_uses: item tags code reads, with what membership does.
no_source_yet / no_use_yet: known gaps, with the reason and where the fix is planned.
creative_only: items with no survival source on purpose, and why.

structures.ascension_worlds:end_ruin: the ruin by the Dragon's arena (the End)
structures.ascension_worlds:end_outpost: an outpost stone on an outer island (the End)

used_by_code.ascension_combat:tome_of_scrapping: Used up at an anvil to wipe an item's enchantments (TomeAnvil)
used_by_code.ascension_combat:tome_of_extraction: Used up in a crafting grid to move an item's enchantments onto a book (ExtractionRecipe)
used_by_code.ascension_combat:rune_chalk: Spent, with experience levels, by a rune page save that removes or replaces a rune (RuneChangeCost)
used_by_code.ascension_worlds:warden_tendril: Wakes Earth's player-built gate, one tendril per gate (GatewayPortalActivation)

creative_only.ascension_atmosphere:oxygen_emitter: Legacy (ADR-0026): air now comes from the Create Air Compressor and the Air Dispenser. Kept registered so rooms in existing worlds keep working; not in the creative tab.
creative_only.ascension_atmosphere:oxygen_refill_stati: Legacy (ADR-0026): the Air Compressor fills tanks now. Kept registered for existing worlds; not in the creative tab.
creative_only.ascension_combat:test_magic_blade: The combat session's test item for magic damage, not a player item.
creative_only.ascension_worlds:archive_plinth: Unbreakable: the Lunar Archive holds its tablets on these, and the story reads them in place.
creative_only.ascension_worlds:colony_plinth: Unbreakable: the colonists' halls' plinth, as the Archive's.
creative_only.ascension_worlds:archive_orrery: Unbreakable: the Archive's orrery, its centrepiece.
creative_only.ascension_worlds:mark_glyph: Unbreakable and drops nothing: a glyph of the script cut into the pylon, read in place.
